history: Mixed, per-example: Example 1 (struct-to-struct cast, equal total storage, wrongly rejected) always-repro'd v1.6.2112..v1.9.2607, unfixed. Example 2 (cast from 0 to a struct whose first bit-field is enum-typed) fixed between v1.8.2502 (repro) and v1.8.2505 (clean); 162-commit/41-file window, release-level attribution only, not isolated to one commit. Example 3 (no diagnostic narrowing a >32-bit bit-field struct to uint) always-repro'd v1.6.2112..v1.9.2607, unfixed. v1.4.1907/v1.5.2010/v1.6.2104/v1.6.2106 are invalid-probe for all three (-HV 2021 unsupported).
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Three-part issue. Examples 1 and 3 (wrong cast rejection; missing narrowing diagnostic) still reproduce on main (89e2f98e2, 1.9.0.5465) and on every stable release back to v1.6.2112, the first to support -HV 2021. Example 2 (cast from 0 to an enum-first bit-field struct) is fixed: errors through v1.8.2502, clean from v1.8.2505 onward including main; the reporter's own plain-field-first control stays clean throughout. Fix is release-bracketed, not commit-isolated (162-commit/41-file window overlapping an unrelated long-vector/SM6.9 refactor). CE verified for Example 1 only (godbolt.org/z/b9vP5dhMK); Examples 2/3 measured via full local per-release history instead.
title: SemaHLSL's FlattenedTypeIterator does not handle bit fields properly.
